items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: But Susie used to do things sometimes.

ctx.x: Did he have a flight in church?

Oh, no, he didn't go to church much. He wouldn't, his mother wouldn't let him sing in church. I told him I would let him sing in church. He must have been on the second liner. Yeah. Oh, he used to go. He didn't tell him to Scott Church like that. No, he used to go along to Dunbar. Oh, yeah, Dunbar. He never done by a church right next to the hall. But I would be trying. I know about that. But Susie used to do things sometimes.
Mrs. Gary, do you remember some of these? You sang about the Promised Land. Do you remember some other hymns about heaven? They loved to sing hymns about heaven, didn't they? Yeah.
